name: MobileValidate API
description:
Check phone numbers and e-mail addresses in real time (`POST /v1/lookup`, up to 100 per request) or in bulk
(`POST /v1/jobs`, up to 50,000 per job): messaging-app and online-account registration, carrier and line type, spam
reputation, and e-mail account existence. `GET /v1/services` lists every check and its price.

**Try it without signing up.** Every example in this document uses the public sandbox key
`mv_test_publicSandboxn9ZgneuhR1B9CRfKG3fulym` and the documented test values (for example `+447700900001` and
`registered@test.mobilevalidate.com`, full list at https://mobilevalidate.com/docs/test-values). The sandbox key
answers only those values (anything else gets `403 sandbox_magic_only`), is limited per IP address (30 requests per
minute, 1,000 per day), accepts jobs of up to 10 rows and no webhooks. Get a personal test key for any number in
test mode at https://mobilevalidate.com/get-test-key.

**Conventions.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and JSON bodies. Money is a decimal string in USD. Phone numbers
and e-mail addresses never go in URLs or headers. `registered` is `false` only for a conclusive negative; `null`
means unknown. Inconclusive answers (`unknown`, `unsupported_country`, invalid, duplicate) are never charged.
Errors share one shape (`error.code`, `message`, `param`, optional `suggestion`, `doc_url`, `request_id`); branch
on `code`. POST requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries. Test keys (`mv_test_…`) never reach a
data source and are never billed.

**Versioning.** v1 changes are additive only. A deprecated endpoint keeps working for at least 12 months and its
responses carry `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and `Link: <https://mobilevalidate.com/changelog>; rel="deprecation"`
headers (policy: https://mobilevalidate.com/docs/versioning). Nothing is deprecated today.

Platform names are used descriptively only; MobileValidate is not affiliated with or endorsed by any platform.
